key_points.point_text: At age 7, at his aunt's house, the author first encountered the santur his cousin had just bought; the cousin let him sit at it and taught him how to hold the mizrab, and he had to be dragged away from it at night's end.
key_points.evidence_quote: دیدار هفت‌سالگی با سنتور خاله ... آخر شب به‌زور او را از پای ساز بلند کردند
key_points.reasoning: Age 7, the aunt's house, the santur, and being dragged away at night are captured. But the source's actor is the cousin who bought the santur and taught him to hold the mizrab. Loglog reassigns the instrument to the aunt (سنتور خاله) and omits the cousin and the mizrab lesson, so the central origin detail is narrowed.

key_points.point_text: The first tune he heard on that santur was likely 'Zard Maliheh' (زرد ملیجه), one of the first songs taught to santur beginners.
key_points.reasoning: Zard Maliheh as the tune heard is captured, but the qualifier that it is one of the first songs taught to santur beginners is dropped. Also the source hedges the identification ('likely'), which is lost.

key_points.point_text: After six months of nagging and sulking, his family finally bought him a santur for 20,000 toman, discounted to 18,000 toman.
key_points.evidence_quote: شش ماه اصرار تا خرید سنتور هجده‌هزار تومانی انجامید
key_points.reasoning: Six months of insistence and the 18,000-toman purchase price are present, but the original 20,000-toman list price and the discount are dropped. A Must have point with a dropped number is at most Partial.

key_points.point_text: He started lessons six months later; the teacher initially came to his home because their city had no school, and only later did the Ershad office open a class where the teacher taught.
key_points.evidence_quote: استاد نخست به خانه می‌آمد چون آموزشگاهی در شهر نبود
key_points.reasoning: The teacher coming home because the city had no school is captured, but the six-month delay before lessons and the later Ershad office class are omitted, narrowing the background.

key_points.point_text: The santur has 72 strings and is hard for an ordinary person to tune, so he had to haul the oversized instrument to class to be tuned, until electronic tuners reached the market and he could tune it himself.
key_points.evidence_quote: برای کوک ۷۲ سیم به کلاس می‌رفت ... با آمدن تیونر دیگر لازم نبود ساز برای کوک به کلاس برده شود
key_points.reasoning: The 72 strings, hauling the oversized instrument to class for tuning, and the arrival of the tuner that removed the need are all captured with correct meaning.

key_points.point_text: The santur is a diatonic instrument: only one dastgah/scale can be played at a time, and modulation requires retuning, which is time-consuming.
key_points.evidence_quote: محدودیت دیاتونیک: یک دستگاه در هر کوک ... مدولاسیون نیازمند صرف زمان برای تغییر کوک بود
key_points.reasoning: The diatonic limitation, one dastgah per tuning, and the time cost of retuning for modulation are all captured intact.

key_points.point_text: This limitation made him feel like a child at a party allowed only one game: to switch he would have to pack up all his toys first, by which time the mood is gone, or else sit silently aside while the other children move to a game he loves.
key_points.evidence_quote: حس بچه‌ای که در مهمانی فقط یک بازی برایش مجاز است ... بازی محبوب دیگران را فقط از گوشه‌ای ساکت نگاه می‌کرد
key_points.reasoning: The core analogy of the child at a party with only one permitted game and watching others' game silently from a corner is captured. The 'packing up toys' clause is absent but the image's meaning survives.

key_points.point_text: Recently a santur was built inspired by the harp, with a set of keys allowing any note to be lowered by a quarter or half step in a fraction of a second.
key_points.evidence_quote: سنتور کلیددار الهام‌گرفته از چنگ ... کلیدها هر نت را در کسری از ثانیه ربع یا نیم پرده زیرتر می‌کنند
key_points.reasoning: The harp-inspired keyed santur and the quarter/half-step change in a fraction of a second are captured with the key technical detail intact.

key_points.point_text: This makes it possible to move quickly from any dastgah to any other with a few clicks, in just seconds.
key_points.evidence_quote: جابه‌جایی میان دستگاه‌ها فقط با چند کلیک ممکن شد
key_points.reasoning: Moving between dastgahs with a few clicks is captured, and the second-scale speed is stated in L015 (مدولاسیون ثانیه‌ای), so the payoff is preserved.

key_points.point_text: He had been thinking about such an instrument for two years but did not know how to bring it safely from Langroud to Langford.
key_points.evidence_quote: وصال پس از دو سال انتظار: از لنگرود تا لنگفورد
key_points.reasoning: The two years of waiting and the Langroud-to-Langford migration thread are captured in the section heading.

key_points.point_text: With the unstinting help of family, friends, officials, and clerics/community leaders, the instrument finally reached him today.
key_points.evidence_quote: با کمک خانواده و دوستان و مسئولان ساز سالم به دستش رسید
key_points.reasoning: The arrival with help from family, friends, and officials is captured, but the clerics/community leaders are omitted and the 'today' timing is dropped, narrowing the credited helper set and the event's immediacy.

key_points.point_text: He tuned it and played, moving from dastgah to dastgah: Isfahan to Segah, Segah to Nava, Nava to Shur, Shur to Homayoun.
key_points.evidence_quote: بی‌وقفه از اصفهان به سه‌گاه و نوا و شور و همایون رفت
key_points.reasoning: The full modulation sequence Isfahan to Segah to Nava to Shur to Homayoun is captured with all named dastgahs intact.

key_points.point_text: He felt like a penned fattened sheep set loose, running without pause: he skipped lunch and played so long his back ached.
key_points.evidence_quote: ناهار نخورد و آن‌قدر زد تا پشتش درد گرفت
key_points.reasoning: Skipping lunch and playing until his back hurt are captured, but the leading sheep-set-loose metaphor is dropped, losing the point's most distinctive image.

key_points.point_text: He felt like the first night his aunt put the mizrabs in his hand, like a child allowed to play any game he wants, like a person free to say anything he wishes.
key_points.evidence_quote: حس شب اول خاله، کودک آزاد در بازی و گوینده آزاد در سخن
key_points.reasoning: All three comparisons, the aunt's first night, the child free in any game, and the speaker free in speech, are captured, and the call-back is noted in L027.

key_points.point_text: He leaves tomorrow on a week of travel and is unhappy at not being home to play, already waiting to return and sit at the instrument.
key_points.evidence_quote: از فردا یک هفته سفر است و دلتنگ ساز ننواخته مانده است
key_points.reasoning: The week of travel starting tomorrow and his longing for the unplayed instrument are captured, preserving the coda.
